snippet.title: 🦾 INTO THE GRID 🦾 Deckbuilding & Dungeon Crawling through cyberspace! - NEXT FEST Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The new Into The Grid demo is coming up on June's Steam Next Fest with a complete visual overhaul, new mechanics and adjusted balance!

- New 3D map, enemy models & environments.
- New Animations, VFX & SFX.
- New Nodes.
- New Cards & Card Upgrade system.
- Reworked Trace System.

Have a taste of the best looking cyberpunk deckbuilder+dungeon crawler combo you ever tried!

Play the demo and wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576200?utm_source=yttrailer
